title: senecio cadiscus
intro: Senecio cadiscus, commonly known as the "Cape marguerite", is a flowering plant species in the daisy family native to South Africa. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Senecio cadiscus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective properties, which can help in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
